hints.title: Two pointers
hints.body: Move one pointer one node at a time and another two nodes at a time.

hints.title: Why does it work?
hints.body: When the fast pointer reaches the end, the slow pointer has covered half the list.

hints.title: Even length
hints.body: Starting both pointers at the head makes the slow pointer land on the second middle node.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
slow = head
fast = head
while fast is not null and fast.next is not null:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next
return slow
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
